description: R-PAR-1 PAR-FOLD, PAR-ORDER, SQL-AGG-ORDER: What exact Double bits do Sum and Avg give when the rows reach the aggregate through a UNION ALL of FO with itself, through a derived UNION of FO with itself, and through joins that fan out rows (FOI joined with FOV on g, inner and left, plain and per group, Sum over each side)? Runs on a fresh copy of r-par-1-fold2 opened read-only through DAO OpenDatabase in one process and one STA; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, and every call's result, HRESULT and DBEngine.Errors are captured.
retentionNote: Designed r-par-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: SELECT Sum(d) AS s, Avg(d) AS a FROM (SELECT d FROM FO UNION ALL SELECT d FROM FO)
SELECT Sum(d) AS s, Avg(d) AS a FROM (SELECT d FROM FO UNION SELECT d FROM FO)
SELECT Sum(a.d) AS s, Avg(a.d) AS av FROM FOI AS a INNER JOIN FOV AS b ON a.g = b.g
SELECT Sum(b.d) AS s, Avg(b.d) AS av FROM FOI AS a INNER JOIN FOV AS b ON a.g = b.g
SELECT a.g, Sum(a.d) AS s, Sum(b.d) AS t FROM FOI AS a INNER JOIN FOV AS b ON a.g = b.g GROUP BY a.g
SELECT a.g, Sum(a.d) AS s, Sum(b.d) AS t FROM FOI AS a LEFT JOIN FOV AS b ON a.g = b.g GROUP BY a.g
SELECT a.g, Sum(b.d) AS t FROM FOV AS a INNER JOIN FOI AS b ON a.g = b.g GROUP BY a.g
